messages:
Anna K: Noticing repeated SSE 'pause' patterns on canary (eu-west-3) since yesterday's console rollout. Connection goes idle for ~7-12s mid-stream, then resumes. Anyone seen similar?
Ben L: saw a cluster of pause spikes around the route-swap window. console shows 429->keepalive flicker, but no clear quota hits. :confused:
Mike R: can you grab a raw trace? e.g., curl -N 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream' and paste the chunk boundaries.
Anna K: pasted trace (sanitized):
```
GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-small
: 200 OK
data: {"delta": "hello"}
... <8s silence> ...
data: {"delta": " world"}
```
Ben L: hmm silence duration matches our probe TTL (8s). Possible probe suppression on pooled sockets during route handoff.
Dmitri S: Are these clients reconnecting? Or staying attached but paused? Important for billing/console counts.
Anna K: clients are staying attached, no resume tokens or reconnects observed. Just silent bytes and then normal flow resumes.
Mike R: Could be proxy-level keepalive suppression we merged in the rollout (we filter small pings to reduce egress). If proxy stops emitting pings during a sticky routing change, some clients observe the pause.
Ben L: That would explain the telemetry gap: console shows session alive (no connection close) but UX sees stalled output -> mismatch between session-counts and last-output-time.
Anna K: UX ask: can we show "last activity" (last SSE payload or ping) per session in the console? Right now only open/closed counts are visible.
Dmitri S: Agree. Also routing nuance: the new sticky-handoff keeps the socket anchored to the old worker for N seconds while new route ramps traffic. If that old worker drops probe frames, it looks like a pause.
Ben L: Proposed action: revert the proxy keepalive suppression flag on canary, add a short-term verbose ping telemetry from edge->control-plane, and surface a dashboard tile for "silent pause rate" by region and route.
Anna K: @ops-bot could you queue a canary rollback for eu-west-3? I'd like to confirm if suppression flag is the culprit.
ops-bot: Deploy job created by Anna K: rollback/proxy-keepalive-flag -> canary eu-west-3. CI smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:
Mike R: Also a longer-term improvement: add a "soft-throttle" metric on the throttler that records when sessions are deprioritized (not fully 429'd) — that can cause throughput dips without alerts.
Ben L: Good idea. Follow-up: sample raw SSE byte timings for 1% of sessions (trace-level) so we can detect chunking vs real silence.
Anna K: I'll run post-rollback checks and stream a few traces to the new sample pipeline. Will report back in ~20m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
